title: Hardening and release candidate
objective: Produce a reproducible, recoverable and benchmarked release candidate for the supported hardware matrix.
acceptance: Debian image and packages build reproducibly from a clean environment.
AppArmor/systemd sandbox profiles cover high-risk processes.
Performance and stability gates pass on the minimum supported reference machine.
Update, rollback/recovery, diagnostics and support procedures are exercised.
Release artifacts, checksums, compatibility notes and user documentation are complete.

history.reason: Roadmap outcome defined; acceptance may be amended before LOCKED.
